description: Code and data companion to 'Verifying an AI-drafted laboratory-interpretation rule base before clinical audit: executable invariants, frozen source-concordance protocols and a hash-frozen benchmark applied to the open Hemoglyph engine' (Bahrami, Tahmasebinejad, Bahrami Samani, 2026). Contains the single-file inference engine (frozen v7 at git tag engine-v7-frozen; current v8.2), Brotli-compressed rule registries 14.1.0 to 15.3.0, the property-based invariant suite, the frozen source-concordance and audit-study protocols and outputs, the verification ledger, the LabPanel-Check conformance package, the pre-specified human-audit protocol and sample, the statistical analysis plan with dated amendments, SHA-256 freeze manifests, and reproduce.sh, which rebuilds the frozen engine and re-derives the main benchmark tables from a clean clone. Patient-level inputs (eICU-CRD demo, MIMIC-IV demo, NHANES, PhysioNet/CinC 2019, UCI, ILPD, PMC-Patients) are not redistributed; download helpers are included.
notes: Code: GNU AGPL-3.0-or-later (LICENSE). Rule registries and aggregated evaluation outputs: CC BY-SA 4.0 (LICENSE-DATA.md); the registries are AI-drafted and single-author curated, status candidate_requires_specialist_validation. Not a medical device. The desktop application built on this engine is separate and not part of this deposit.
